item.title: ConformTXT 0.6.20
item.description: - The first paste into a brand-new email in Mimestream or Mail waits a little longer for the email to be ready, so it matches instead of coming in as plain text. - ⌃⌘V right after a paste it can't swap keeps beeping (and pasting nothing) until you type, click or press ⌘Z, so the text is never pasted twice. - Invisible characters left by ChatGPT's link chips are taken out.
